product_title: Royal Ganesha & Elephant Pearl Toran (38 inches)
product_description: Welcome prosperity and traditional elegance into your home with this handcrafted toran, featuring a Lord Ganesha centerpiece, vibrant pink lotus motifs, decorative elephants, sacred Shubh-Labh accents, intricate golden detailing, and elegant pearl tassels. Perfect for Diwali, pooja rooms, weddings, and festive entrance décor.
product_care_suggestion: Gently dust with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water, moisture, and direct sunlight.
Handle pearls and decorative elements with care.
Store in a cool, dry place after use.
